analysis.summary: Vikram Thermo (India) Limited recorded a revenue of Rs. 12,623.06 lakhs from continuing operations and a total Profit After Tax of Rs. 809.85 lakhs for FY 2024-25. The company successfully executed the demerger of its Aromatic Chemicals (Diphenyl Oxide) business into Vikram Aroma Limited, which listed and commenced trading on BSE in March 2025. guidance.claim: The company's focus is to build a sustainable business model with a focus on profitable revenue growth and launch of research-based high-margin products.
guidance.quote: The company's focus is to build a sustainable business model with a focus on profitable revenue growth and launch of research based high margin products suiting to the specific needs of customers in domestic as well as overseas markets.

guidance.claim: The company plans to venture into new markets with favorable competition and focus on new, complex products in fiscal 2024.
guidance.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's PAN-India presence and expanding global footprint have contributed significantly to its growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Our extensive PAN-India presence, along with a steadily expanding global footprint, has significantly contributed to the Company's growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through research-driven products in domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's PAN-India presence and expanding global footprints have yielded rich dividends.
demand_outlook.quote: The PAN - INDIA presence with global footprints expanding to newer territories have yielded rich dividends to your company.

demand_outlook.claim: Management plans to leverage R&D capabilities, domain expertise, and customer-centric products to drive growth.
demand_outlook.quote: We will leverage our R&D capabilities, domain expertise, and our customer-centric products to attain newer heights.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 10% on equity shares, amounting to Rs. 1 per share for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 10% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The dividend payout will result in a total outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850/- (Previous Year Rs. 2,35,18,388/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not transfer any amount from profit to reserves for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has not transferred any amount to the reserves from the profit for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: Equity shares of Vikram Aroma Limited were allotted to company shareholders under the demerger scheme.
capital_allocation.quote: In accordance with the approved Scheme, the equity shares of the resulting company, M/s Vikram Aroma Limited, have been duly allotted to the shareholders of your Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 7.5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 7.5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 0.75 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The recommended dividend payout will result in a total outflow of Rs. 2,35,18,388/-.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's risk framework addresses external and internal risks, including extreme events like calamities and disasters.
risks_headwinds.quote: The process involves identifying both external and internal risks and the readiness to respond to extreme risks like calamities and disasters.

risks_headwinds.claim: Risks are continuously monitored across business strategy, operations, legal compliance, financial reporting, IT, and cyber security.
risks_headwinds.quote: Risks are being continuously identified in relation to business strategy, business continuity/contingency plans, operations and transactions, statutory / legal compliance, financial reporting, information technology system, cyber security and overall internal control framework.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has implemented a Risk Management Policy to identify elements of risk that may threaten its existence.
risks_headwinds.quote: Your Company has developed and implemented a Risk Management Policy which includes identification of elements of risk, if any, which in the opinion of the Board, may threaten the existence of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted global uncertainties and challenges stemming from aftershocks of the COVID-19 pandemic.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the global uncertainties and unprecedented challenges that came in our way through the aftershocks of covid-19 pandemic, we remained resilient and steadfast in our commitment to deliver value to all our stakeholders.

management_commitments.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

management_commitments.claim: The company is committed to consistently investing in R&D, exploring emerging technologies, and enhancing its product portfolio.
management_commitments.quote: The company remains committed to consistently investing in R&D, exploring emerging technologies and enhancing its product portfolio to meet the evolving needs of the market.
